sourcePage.title: Floor Plans | Medical Education Telemedicine Building
sourcePage.author: somedcom

observations: Plans show actual lower/first/second/third-level program arrangements; acquired artifacts cover L1-L3.
L3 shows student lounge/offices and EdCom/IT core along the north edge, with learning communities and group rooms on the west and southwest sides.
limitations: Downloaded JPEG originals are only 228-235 pixels wide; fine room numbers, wall junctions and door positions are not reliably legible.
Large program labels and colored overlays cover parts of the plan.
Preconstruction preliminary plans from 2009 cannot be assumed to match the building completed in 2011 or subsequent partitions.
No room polygons or schedule joins were created from these images.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Higher-resolution numbered final/as-built third-floor plan; verify core and perimeter against FIS L1/L2 before registration.
